text:
Sam: FYI main pipeline just turned red after the automerge from @Mike — smoke/gpu-alloc failing on the new allocator change. Anyone able to grab?
DeployBot: [CI] build/4827 failed: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/4827 :rotating_light:
Infra Bot: autotriage: failure class detected: gpu-alloc-fail (alloc_error) — tests impacted: smoke/gpu-init, smoke/kvalloc. Suggested next steps: rerun job, if reproducible start bisect.
Anya: I can take a look in ~15m. can someone rerun the job once so we have fresh logs?
Mike: sorry — that was the fast-automerge for my perf tweak. kicking a rerun now: `ci rerun 4827`
DeployBot: Rerun queued: build/4828 (child of 4827) — logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/4828
Infra Bot: build/4828 completed: FAILED — same assertion in gpu allocator: `KVAlloc::alloc(): OOM after 3 attempts`
Priya: hmm if it's OOM maybe the change reduced headroom. @Mike can you share the commit SHA?
Mike: sure: `8f3c2a9` — change adjusts per-shard reserved cache to 0.6 -> 0.5. I thought it was safe on large instances.
Sam: attaching minimal log excerpt: ```
[2026-03-18T20:12:03Z] ERROR gpu_allocator - allocation failed: requested=1.2GB, available=896MB, attempts=3
[2026-03-18T20:12:03Z] INFO smoke_test - test name=smoke/gpu-init shard=2
```
Anya: thanks. I'll try a local reproduce on a dev GPU image, but we should bisect to be sure it's this commit and not a scheduling regression.
Priya: I can run a bisect on CI (quick binary search over recent commits). @Sam can you confirm we have a stable window to revert if needed?
Sam: yes we can revert. if bisect lands on 8f3c2a9 then revert and hotfix.
Priya: starting bisect now across last 6 merges. kick off command: `ci bisect --range=6 --baseline=main~6`
DeployBot: Bisect job started: bisect/129. Progress updates will be posted here.
Infra Bot: bisect/129 reported first failing commit: 8f3c2a9 (matches Mike's change). Repro rate: 3/3 CI runs failed.
Priya: confirmed. reproduces consistently on medium-gpu pool. Recommendation: revert `8f3c2a9` or bump reserved cache back to 0.6 and run smoke. Which do you prefer @Mike?
Mike: reverting now and I'll iterate on a less aggressive change. sending revert PR in 5m: https://git.internal.redwood/reverts/293
Sam: thanks. @Priya can you watch the rerun after revert merges and close the bisect?
Priya: will do. once revert merges I'll trigger `ci rerun` on the original pipeline.
DeployBot: Revert PR merged: build/4835 triggered.
DeployBot: Rerun queued: build/4836.
Infra Bot: build/4836 PASSED — smoke/gpu-init and smoke/kvalloc green. :white_check_mark:
Sam: nice. thanks @Priya @Anya for quick triage and @Mike for fast revert. I'll follow up with a postmortem note in #postmortems and add a guard in the kernel allocator change checklist.
Anya: +1. next time let's add a forced smoke run on medium-gpu before automerge.
Mike: agreed. sorry for the noise, will do a canary next time. :raised_hands:
Priya: closing bisect and marking as resolved. update: created follow-up ticket INFRA-721 for canary step.
Sam: closing thread.
